knowledge.title: What Tallgrass sells
knowledge.text: Tallgrass is payroll and HR software for restaurant groups with 3 to 30 locations. It runs payroll from the timeclock hours each site reports, handles tip pooling and tip credits by state, and files payroll taxes. Priced per employee per month. Customers switch to us from a bookkeeper plus spreadsheets, or from a general payroll tool that does not handle tips.

knowledge.title: Customer profile, 2026
knowledge.text: We have about 600 restaurant group customers, mostly in Texas, the Southeast and the Midwest. The typical customer runs 3 to 30 locations with 40 to 600 hourly staff and an owner or a controller who runs payroll. Most come to us when they open their third or fourth site and tips, overtime and state filings stop fitting in a spreadsheet. The buyer is the owner, the controller or the director of operations.

knowledge.title: How we win and lose deals
knowledge.text: We win when the group already has a POS that exports hours cleanly, because onboarding takes a week instead of a month. We lose when hours live in three different timeclocks. Our onboarding team maps each POS export by hand today.

site.title: Ledgerline POS, point of sale built for independent restaurants
site.description: Orders, payments, timeclock and reporting for independent restaurants and growing restaurant groups.
site.markdown:
# Point of sale built for independent restaurants

Ledgerline runs the front of house for more than 3,000 restaurant locations: counter service, full service and bars. Orders, payments, online ordering, a built-in timeclock and end-of-day reports in one system.

## Built for groups that are growing

Run one menu across every site. See sales, labor and tips per location in one dashboard. Add a new site in a day.

## Timeclock and labor

Staff clock in on the terminal. Managers see hours, breaks and overtime as the shift happens. Export hours to your payroll provider at the end of the pay period.

## Partners

We work with payment processors, delivery platforms and accounting tools. Our partner program opened in September 2026.

## Who uses Ledgerline

Independent restaurants, cafes and bars, and restaurant groups with up to 50 locations, across the US.

first_step.title: A 30 minute call to compare ten customers
first_step.detail: You bring ten groups on Ledgerline that are adding sites this year. I bring ten of ours that run on a POS with a timeclock. If five of them look like the same company, we have an offer. If not, we both learned something in half an hour.
first_step.ask: Pick a week, and tell me whether the timeclock export is the same for every Ledgerline group or differs by plan.
